# trembita

> Distributed Raft + actor framework for Rust — one codebase, N nodes.

- Docs: https://trembita.dev/
- API: https://docs.rs/trembita
- Crates: https://crates.io/crates/trembita
- Source: https://gitlab.com/lemarco/trembita

## Start here

- Getting started: https://trembita.dev/guide/getting-started
- Scenarios: https://trembita.dev/scenarios/
- Examples: https://trembita.dev/examples
- Changelog: https://trembita.dev/changelog

## Install

```toml
[dependencies]
trembita = "0.3"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros", "signal"] }
```

Use feature `dev-certs` for local single-node without PEM files.
